svg.title: Clearpath system map: lead intake and AWS validation topology
svg.desc: Paid lead providers feed existing GoHighLevel CRM workflows. A planned compatible webhook path and a separate historical CSV import reach the Clearpath FastAPI service. PostgreSQL stores normalized leads, properties, sources, outcomes, scores, and market snapshots for a read-focused dashboard. The documented AWS validation topology used CloudFront and WAF, an Application Load Balancer, ECS Fargate in private app subnets, RDS Proxy with IAM database authentication, and RDS PostgreSQL in isolated data subnets. GitHub Actions used OIDC to publish an ARM64 image to ECR. The AWS resources were torn down after validation; the external GoHighLevel integration was not verified.
svg.text: Lead operations in; source decisions out.
Keep CRM follow-up in place; make provider performance queryable.
AWS VALIDATED BRIEFLY · THEN TORN DOWN
Where leads come from · what the analytics layer answers
